notablePrerequisites: Gwenna does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{B} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Grim Wanderer by paying {1}{B}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Grim Wanderer enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Sheltering Ancient from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {1}{G} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Sheltering Ancient by paying {1}{G}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
Sheltering Ancient enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Grim Wanderer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
